description: run creates directory, replays state, returns early for terminal token; otherwise initializes state, checks STOP/page limit, forms encoded URL, handles bounded consecutive 503 responses, parses OAI error/token, writes compressed page before durable state append.

inverse: Terminal empty state token and STOP prevent requests. >20 consecutive 503 cannot continue sleeping; other HTTP status errors abort without checkpoint of that failed response. Source-derived network bounds.

Last-state tuple admits many earlier lines, ignored short/header rows and unparseable counts mapped zero. Gzip page plus state constrains body/token at commit but cannot determine all request timing or discarded failed responses.
limitations: No network/DNS/download, real catalog/corpus/model/teacher or database execution. Effect paths are source-derived; finite helper tests are not universal verification. No executable percentage surrogate or speed claim; future caps require metric/domain/reference and remain 1/2/5/10%.
state: Resume uses last valid >=3-cell nonheader line's page/token and cumulative parsed record counts. noRecordsMatch appends terminal state without gzip page. Successful page commit stores body before token checkpoint; crash can leave page ahead of state.
